correctness.rationale: Orthogonality applied to P squared gives M=sum_{a in {0,1,2}² x {0,...,4}} |sum_{u+v=a} c_u c_v|², with 45 indices. Scalar and three coordinate-character modulations uniquely set c000,c100,c010,c001 to 1, leaving exactly q^8 arrays, each with q^4 original configurations. Independently implemented exact Gaussian/Eisenstein-lattice convolution enumeration tested all 256+6561+65536+1679616=1,751,969 normalized arrays; obtained minima (220,210,188,196), next attained values (228,216,196,200), and normalized minimizer counts (27,48,6,36), agreeing with source. The source CHECK.py additionally supplies exact orbit-representative reconstruction and an independent difference-correlation identity. On finite tori with each cyclic period strictly larger than the corresponding squared-polynomial degree (m,n>=3,ell>=5), the 45 sum frequencies do not alias, proving transfer for all arrays. Exhaustiveness applies only to finite phase alphabets, not continuous unimodular phases.
